    StartersBoston clam chowder with oyster crackersCreamy clam chowder with bacon and potato, oyster crackers on the sideHow to make it3 rashers of bacon, diced1 onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced2 tbsp plain flour400ml fish stock300g potatoes, diced1kg clams or vongole, cleaned300ml thickened cream1 box oyster crackers1 small bunch chivesFry the bacon until crisp, then add the onion and celery and cook until soft.Stir in the flour, then the fish stock and potato. Simmer until the potato is tender.Add the clams, cover and cook until open, then pick out the empty shells.Stir in the cream and heat through. Season with pepper and serve with oyster crackers and chives.Watermelon toss buffalo wingsCrisp baked wings in hot sauce butter, blue cheese dip and celeryHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings2 tsp baking powder1 tsp salt50g butter100ml hot sauce100g blue cheese150g sour cream2 tbsp mayonnaise1 lemon1 bunch celery, cut into sticksPat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.Bake on a rack at 220°C, turning once, until crisp.Mash the blue cheese with the sour cream, mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through it. Serve with the dip and celery.Fried Ipswich clams with tartareMullins family style, yelling included.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMullins family roast beef and gravyRoast beef, crisp potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravyHow to make it1.5kg beef topside2 tbsp Dijon mustard2 garlic cloves, crushed5 tbsp vegetable oil1.2kg potatoes, quartered4 carrots, halved1 tbsp honey1 tbsp plain flour400ml beef stockRub the beef with the mustard, garlic, a little oil and salt.Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in oil.Roast the beef at 200°C for medium rare, with the potatoes on a separate tray.Toss the carrots in the honey and add for the last part of the roasting.Rest the beef.Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer to a gravy.SweetsBoston cream pieSponge cake layered with vanilla custard and chocolate glazeHow to make it5 eggs (3 yolks for the custard, 2 whole for the cake)210g caster sugar2 tbsp cornflour420ml full cream milk1 tsp vanilla extract125g butter, soft200g self-raising flour100g dark chocolate100ml thickened creamWhisk the yolks, some of the sugar and the cornflour, then whisk in hot milk. Return to the pan and stir until thick. Add the vanilla.Chill the custard.Beat the butter and remaining sugar, add the whole eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.Bake in a 20cm tin at 180°C, then cool.Split the cake and fill with custard.Melt the chocolate with the cream and pour over the top.DrinksAshburn and Mullins whiskey sourIrish whiskey, lemon and egg white shaken foamy, bitters and cherryHow to make it240ml Irish whiskey4 lemons, juiced80ml sugar syrup4 egg whites (from 4 eggs)1 bottle aromatic bitters1 jar cocktail cherries1 bag iceShake the whiskey, lemon juice, sugar syrup and egg white hard without ice in a jar or shaker. Repeat for each drink.Add ice and shake again, then strain into short glasses over fresh ice.Top the foam with a couple of dashes of bitters and drop in a cherry.Pint of Boston lagerA few, then Ashburn gives her car away.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
